finding.comment: the slurped consumer aggregates the per-line objects into an array before any(.[]; .ok), matching the JSONL format

files.patch:
--- a/scripts/verify.sh
+++ b/scripts/verify.sh
@@ -4,4 +5,5 @@
 set -euo pipefail
+jq -cr '.checks[]' <<<"$report" > "$rows_jsonl"
+if ! jq -s 'any(.[]; .ok)' <"$rows_jsonl"; then
+  echo "failing check present" >&2
+fi
